kits.name: Toyota Camry 2020–2024 2.5L Filter & Spark Plug Kit
kits.description:
Toyota Camry 2020–2024 2.5L Filter & Spark Plug Kit

Spin-on oil filter, engine air filter, cabin air filter and a full set of four iridium spark plugs for the 2.5L four-cylinder gas (non-hybrid) Camry.
This kit is assembled by DrivoraParts from individual genuine Toyota parts; it is not a Toyota-packaged kit.

Kit contents

1 x Genuine Toyota Spin-On Oil Filter 90915-YZZN1 (90915-YZZN1)
1 x Genuine Toyota Engine Air Filter 17801-F0050 (17801-F0050)
1 x Genuine Toyota Cabin Air Filter (Deodorizing) 87139-0E040 (87139-0E040)
4 x Genuine Toyota Iridium Spark Plug 90919-01289 (90919-01289)

Engine oil and the oil drain plug gasket are not included.

Specifications

Brand: Toyota (genuine parts)
Condition: New
Engines: A25A-FKS
Fitment: 2020–2024 Toyota Camry (2.5L gas, non-hybrid)
Restriction (87139-0E040, 2020-2024 Camry): charcoal filter; North American-built (Japan-built charcoal number is 87139-58010 on Corolla; Camry split not confirmed)
Restriction (90919-01289, 2018-2024 Camry): 2.5L gas; hybrid not confirmed

Confirm fitment with your VIN before ordering.
